title: Price Fixer protected sites
description: Pages where the exact amount matters: payments, banking, trading, crypto, accounting, tax, invoices. They are left untouched while pauseOnPayment is on (the default). The popup says "Paused on this <reason> for safety". Loaded by src/sites/siteGuard.ts.

hostGroups.description: Every page on these hosts and their subdomains is protected, whatever the path. Groups are checked in order; the first match gives the reason.

id.description: Unique group name, for readability only.

pathSegmentGroups.description: URL path segments (or subdomain labels) that mark a protected step on any site. Matched as whole segments, so a product slug like "checkout-counter-toy" does not count. Don't add "cart": a basket is still browsing.

cardFieldSelectors.description: CSS selectors for card-entry fields and gateway iframes, for sites that render their own card form instead of redirecting to a gateway.

domain.description: Bare lowercase domain, no scheme or www. Also matches its subdomains.

reason.description: Shown in the popup: "Paused on this <reason> for safety". A short noun phrase, e.g. "bank site".
